comment: The workspace file is `.archicode.yaml` (wave 019, run 0144, #133, decision T9): a rename with no alias. A folder that holds `workspace.yaml` and no `.archicode.yaml` is told with one sentence, the same in both tools, word for word: the command line prints it as the `error:` line (exit 1) before anything is loaded, the editor shows it as the reason the folder cannot be opened. WorkspaceFileNameTest.java (command line, and `editor serve`) and workspace-file-name.test.js (editor) read this file; `files` are written in an empty folder. `expect.loads`: the folder opens; `expect.error`: the sentence. Wave 020, run 0147 (#146): `expect.failure` says which kind of failure the folder is, the same in both tools and never decided by the words of a message: `unreadable` (the workspace file cannot be had: there is none, or it is not a file; the command line raises WorkspaceFileException, reason MISSING, the editor sets fatalErrorKind `unreadable` and its landing card says "could not be read"), `renamed` (the folder holds the former name only: reason FORMER_NAME, kind `renamed`, the card says the sentence) or `content` (the file is there and what it says is wrong, whatever file name the sentence holds: an ArchiCodeException that is no WorkspaceFileException, kind null, the card says the sentence as it is). `directories` are folders made in the empty folder before the test (a folder where the file should be).
sentence: `workspace.yaml` is no longer the name of the workspace file: rename it to `.archicode.yaml` (`git mv workspace.yaml .archicode.yaml`), or tell the command line where it is with `-w workspace.yaml`

cases.what: only the old name: the sentence, nothing else is read
the old name beside the new one: the new one is the workspace file and the old one is a file like another (no manifest reads it here)
no workspace file at all: the file is missing, not wrong
a folder where the file should be: nothing to read
the file names a key that does not exist: its sentence names the file, it is not a failure to read it
the file still has `settings.plateaus`: told as it is
the file is not valid YAML: read, found wrong
the file is not a mapping: read, found wrong
a manifests path that leaves the folder: the sentence says .archicode.yaml twice, and is not reworded
